notes: Adamsdown_Boy - information as at v8.0.0.6 PvE / PvE-Boss / PvE-BossSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): PvE pick for killing boss-tier Subjugators. As per @mossy_max (https://x.com/mossy_max/status/1804893174965338387) - boss-tier Subjugators have a 20% damage reduction to all non-matching damage, going up to 30% DR to all damage after they "screech", which counts as a shield in-game and reacts to shield-based trait perks. The Ilkelos Sniper rifle - still obtainable from the Seraph Shield mission - is shapeable, so you can craft exactly the roll to help. First, Arrowhead Brake to help with recoil (if you just drop one, Chambered Compensator or Polygonal Rifling will also to help land consistent crits). Then, as a Backup Mag mod gets you to the max of 7 shots, Seraph Rounds for all the benefits of High-Caliber, Armor-Piercing and Ricihet Rounds, or Steady Rounds for more recoil control. Enhanced Overflow in the first trait perk column overflows the mag to 15, or Fourth Times the charm will provide 10 crit hits without a reload. Finally, Under-Over provides +50% damage against the boss Subjugator "shield". Unfortunately, you won't see any benefot from the Rasputin's Arsenal origin trait as you're not actually breaking any shields. Recommended MW: Stability, with a Backup Mag mod
Speedrunner's Shopping List: "Quick ranged hitscan kills/Breaking eyes" (good for: Garden of Salvation, Spire of the Watcher)

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "I still have my season 11 Ikelos sniper. I still use it and I don’t think there’s a large reason for me to grind out the crafted version. For those who don’t have the 2nd version of the Ikelos sniper, overflow and focused fury are a very fun combo for maximizing your damage per magazine. I prefer high-impact reserves and fourth time’s the charm for ammo refunding. Something about damage numbers going up consistently makes my smooth brain happy." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "In PvP you will have to decide if this sniper is good enough. Snipers are incredibly personal and what works for one person will not always work for others. The zoom, the scope, the feel will all determine your success. Elemental capacitor on arc subclasses will maximize your handling, but elemental capacitor on stasis or void is another great option for movement speed and stability, respectively." Recommended MW - Handling.
